_note: How a host agent platform talks to the guard. The guard works on canonical tool names (Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, Bash, Agent) and on a hook payload of {tool_name, tool_input, cwd, agent_id, agent_type}. A host whose names or fields differ gets an entry here (tool_aliases maps the host's tool name to a canonical one; passthrough_tools lists extra host tools that touch neither files, shell nor network and may pass; identity names the payload fields). Any tool the guard does not recognise is BLOCKED, or a small wrapper that rewrites its payload. Only entries that have been verified against the host's documentation should be added.
